name: bento
description: Tidy your activity bar. Drag views from any extension into a container of your own, name it whatever you like, and lose the icons you no longer need.

viewsWelcome.contents:
This container is empty.

Drag a view's title bar from any other activity bar container and drop it here. Then right-click the icon it came from and choose Hide from Activity Bar.

Turn more containers on in [settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22bento%22).

bento.names.markdownDescription: Custom names for each container, e.g. `{ "bento1": "AI Tools" }`. Changing a name requires a window reload — Bento will prompt you. Leave a container out to keep its default name.
